Adhan Listening Catalog فهرس الاستماع للأذان

1270 recordings indexed. Each is a distinct recording, already deduplicated. For evaluation listening only: nothing here is cleared for use in the app. Full details are in index.csv. Recordings that are only available as links are in links-only.csv. Recordings outside the target regions are in excluded-out-of-scope.csv. Performer names come from source labels, not from listening.

Note: the bulk collection audio was removed from the codespace on 2026-10-09 to free disk space. Only the recordings added afterwards (Taha Al-Fashni) are still playable here. Every other entry keeps its source link.

Egyptian voices (148) Gulf voices (224) Masjid al-Haram, Makkah (289) Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, Madinah (187) Haram series (mosque unconfirmed) (19) Unidentified recordings (403)
